_meta.purpose: Cached host/tooling probe so per-session setup checks aren't re-run. TTL-bounded: if 'probed' is older than ttl_hours, treat as stale and re-probe (see .claude/scripts/state.sh sibling tooling / each engine's doctor).

note: Null = not yet probed. Populate by running a probe at session start; consumers must check ttl_hours before trusting these values.
